scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older grey-bearded adviser gestures toward a blue night landscape while a younger long-haired man listens from a wooden chair. A clay oil lamp lights their layered robes, a low table, and the textured stone room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The painting imagines Ahithophel presenting his proposal to Absalom. The lamplit council and night doorway evoke the proposed pursuit that night; they do not show the twelve thousand men assembled or the pursuit underway. David remains outside the scene. Faces, garments, and room are illustrative conventions rather than historical likenesses or verified architecture.
